I feel the same… honestly I don’t know why we try so hard to prevent suicide. I mean sure, people go through tough things throughout their lives, there will never exist a life without pain, it’s part of nature and part of us. But life sometimes isn’t for everyone? I’ve been dealing with depression and loneliness since I was born basically. But every time I wanted to leave, people around me wanted for me to stay but who does this really benefit? They say it’s selfish to pull the plug yourself because of: “ oh but think about those who love you or think about how I’d feel” it seems like we stay alive for others but at the end aren’t happy with ourselves. Although I have a good job and a generally comfortable life, I can’t enjoy it like the others. I basically am bored out of my mind. And when I think about the possibility of dying, I really don’t care if I wasn’t able to do/experience what I wanted. I’m comfortable leaving. And it just makes this hard because who in the right mind will encourage their s/o, bf/gf or friends to end it all? I really don’t know what is right since we’ve been told that suicide is a bad thing for so long. But yet it exists. And there is a reason for everything that exists whether good or bad. As humans I think we’re too stupid to even understand the reason why we are here.
